# V373 — qualified offline SFT component, before pipeline implementation

Maintenance scope: trusted Windows x64 / CPython3.14, finite CPU-only synthetic qualification. This selects an opt-in SFT implementation; it does not select a consumer model, require history for NEW, or admit a complete training pipeline.

Official TRL1.12.0 SFT source identity and Apache2 LICENSE were acquired/compared in V369.58 exact PyPI wheels are installed in a fresh isolated venv using --no-index --no-deps --require-hashes --no-compile. No global install. PEP658/METADATA and wheel RECORD integrity were checked in V371 and V373; these establish publication identity, not reproducible native-source builds or signature verification.

Safetensors0.8.0 is rejected; exact official0.9.0rc0 replaces it only in this opt-in qualification lock. Git tag v0.9.0-rc.0 commit77a5d1d5234918bc9da7637ad178dac57f0e2834. It remains a prerelease.32 declared native registry components report no OSV findings. Aggregate423 declared identities retain RUSTSEC-2024-0436 for paste1.0.15; it is INFO/unmaintained, not a fixed vulnerability. Exact tokenizers0.23.2 tag lock, crate registry checksum and docs.rs manifest show a proc-macro build dependency. The upstream maintainer reverted the pastey replacement. Retain this maintenance finding as nonblocking for executing the already built exact official wheel with local validated inputs; no Rust build occurs. New target/source build, changed advisory or patch reopens this disposition. No scanner suppression or zero-all-graph claim.

Native C/C++ build configurations are preserved (Torch MKL2026.1, oneDNN3.12.0; Arrow25.0.1; NumPy OpenBLAS0.3.34.106.0). Declared SBOM scans do not establish exhaustive binary component coverage. Full candidate supply-chain/offensive security remains TEST03; this narrow trusted synthetic SDK qualification is not admission for private corpus execution or deployment. Consumer runtime admission is mandatory before touching private history. No private input is admitted by these fixtures.

Actual qualification:4592 random GPT2 parameters,3steps, completion labels mask prompts, changed weights, safe serialization and exact reload, independent heldout, deterministic replay from reset weights, corrupt/truncated/huge safetensors rejection, absent local model rejection and ValueError for completely truncated targets. Job Object supervisor records450846720 peak commit bytes, exit0 and empty tree. Python network denial probe passes and actual training makes zero attempts; this is not a native-code firewall or hostile-user sandbox. No external model weights, provider, remote code, GPU or PEFT extra selected.

Licenses are used internally without third-party redistribution in the library. Exact wheel license texts/NOTICES remain in the unmodified wheels; BSD/MIT/Apache/PSF/ISC/Zlib and component notices are preserved. certifi/tqdm MPL2 file-level obligations and NumPy bundled runtime notices are retained, not relabeled permissive. Tokenizers missing wheel LICENSE is paired with Apache2 text from its exact tag. No model or dataset license is inferred from code. A consumer distribution/build must satisfy its exact component obligations and native coverage; no global legal approval is issued.

G0 publication/source identity: PASS for this exact component. G1 internal use with retained notices: PASS for scope. G2 ML/manual training separation: PASS. G3 inspected SFTConfig/SFTTrainer/Trainer boundary: PASS. G4 actual mask, replay, persistence and negative probes: PASS. G5 trusted synthetic offline reference, bounded input and declared advisories disposition: PASS for scope only. G6 finite job/tree/memory, deterministic no-resume replay: PASS. G7 isolated candidate/failed environment preserved, explicit update and rollback to rejected-not-active lane: PASS. G8 exact reusable qualification harness, locks and oracles: PASS for component selection only. Whole pipeline and consumer target gates remain open.

The necessary pipeline glue will remain AUTHORED; HF supplies training, tokenization and serialization. This record is produced before that glue. Core reference supervisor reuse follows WINDOWS_REFERENCE_TELEMETRY_RUNTIME0.1.0; no homegrown trainer is introduced.

Official sources: [release](https://github.com/safetensors/safetensors/releases/tag/v0.9.0-rc.0), [maintenance advisory](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2024-0436.html), [tokenizers revert](https://github.com/huggingface/tokenizers/commit/9bafd8262535b7a7814b2c258fbfd0ee63d682e2), [proc-macro manifest](https://docs.rs/crate/paste/1.0.15/source/Cargo.toml).
